title: Wso2am: Improper handling of configuration values in ZKConfig in Apache ZooKeeper 3 (CVE-2026-24308)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability exists in the wso2am package due to improper handling of configuration values in ZKConfig within Apache ZooKeeper 3. This flaw affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The vulnerability allows an attacker to cause a confidentiality breach without requiring privileges or user interaction. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
